input.command:
cd D:\npqo
$pkg = Get-Content -Raw package.json
$pkg = $pkg.Replace('vite --port 5173 --strictPort', 'vite --port 5180 --strictPort')
Set-Content -Path package.json -Value $pkg -NoNewline -Encoding ascii
$cfg = Get-Content -Raw vite.config.ts
$cfg = $cfg.Replace('server: { port: 5173, strictPort: true }', 'server: { port: 5180, strictPort: true }')
Set-Content -Path vite.config.ts -Value $cfg -NoNewline -Encoding ascii
$existing = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5180 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $existing) { Start-Process -FilePath 'cmd.exe' -ArgumentList '/c','npm run dev > dev-server.log 2>&1' -WindowStyle Hidden }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
Get-Content dev-server.log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
(Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:5180/).Content | Select-Object -First 8
